content.short: Virtual USD accounts and global freelancer payments.
content.description: Parallax is a stablecoin-powered payments platform that gives freelancers, contractors, and global teams virtual USD accounts and fast international payouts. Workers can receive salary or invoices in stablecoins such as USDC and USDT, hold a dollar balance, and seamlessly convert and withdraw to local bank accounts or wallets, using blockchain rails across networks like Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon to settle quickly and cheaply. For businesses, Parallax offers a way to pay distributed teams and contractors around the world without the delays and high fees of traditional cross-border payroll. By combining a free USD account with stablecoin settlement and local cash-out, Parallax helps people in emerging markets get paid in dollars and keep more of what they earn.
content.meta: Parallax offers virtual USD accounts and stablecoin payouts for global freelancers. Discover Parallax and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
